title: CLR internals checkpoint
prompt: Implement `static (string ilName, bool isSealed, int methodCount) Inspect<T>()` using reflection: return the type's full name, whether it is sealed, and its declared instance method count. Then implement `static string DispatchDescription(Type t)` returning exactly "virtual" if t has any virtual methods (declared, instance), "interface" if it implements any interfaces, otherwise "direct". The graded insight: typeof(List<int>) reports sealed, virtual, and interface all at once.

tests.name: inspect-sealed
dispatch-desc
